title: AI server prices jump up to 45% after contracts signed, putting buyers at suppliers' mercy
html: AI server suppliers, including Dell Technologies, Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE), Lenovo, and Supermicro, are reportedly demanding price increases of up to 45% on equipment months after contracts were agreed, reflecting mounting pressure from soaring memory...
